overview:
Thrill and tranquillity in one weekend: this **1 Night / 2 Days** Rishikesh group trip leaves Delhi at 10:30 PM, with pickups at New Delhi Metro Station and Akshardham Metro Station, and departs every Thursday and Friday. You travel overnight by AC Tempo Traveller and reach Haridwar in the morning.

Day 1 starts at Har Ki Pauri for Ganga Aarti, then moves to the campsite in Rishikesh for breakfast, river rafting, evening games and a bonfire with music. Day 2 covers Ram Jhula, Janki Setu, Parmarth Niketan Ghat and the local markets before the evening drive back. The camp has attached washrooms, coolers and swimming pool access. Prices start at ₹4,999 per person on quad sharing (5% GST and activity charges extra).

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The AC Tempo Traveller leaves Delhi at 10:30 PM. You can board at New Delhi Metro Station or Akshardham Metro Station. Departures run every Thursday and Friday.

faqs.q: How much does the Rishikesh trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹4,999 per person on quad sharing, ₹5,499 on triple sharing and ₹5,999 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

faqs.q: Is river rafting included in the price?
faqs.a: Rafting is part of the Day 1 plan, but activity charges are not included in the package price. You pay for activities separately.
One night of camping in Rishikesh with an attached washroom, a cooler and swimming pool access. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

1 night of camping, 2 breakfasts, 1 snacks and 1 dinner, a bonfire with music, and experienced trip leaders. Travel is by AC Tempo Traveller. Meals during transit and activity charges are not included.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
